translations.web: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
translations.bsb: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, out of olive wood.
translations.kjv: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
translations.asv: And in the oracle he made two cherubim of olive-wood, each ten cubits high.
